subject.title: Skills silently truncated - user-created skills invisible with no warning or prioritization

question: Should OpenClaw handle skills prompt overflow with the narrow omitted-key visibility repair first, add priority/pinning config now, or fold this into broader smart skill indexing?
rationale: The source-level truncation behavior is real, but several proposed remedies add new core configuration and prompt-selection policy, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Stage Omitted-Key Visibility First
options.body: Land or repair the narrow omitted-skill lookup path in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/42637, then evaluate priority and smart loading separately.

options.title: Design Priority/Pinning First
options.body: Hold the narrow fix until maintainers choose a durable `skills.entries` or per-context required-skills config contract.

options.title: Move To Smart Indexing
options.body: Treat the remaining work as part of a broader lazy-loading/indexing design with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89361 as the product track.

recommendation.title: Stage Omitted-Key Visibility First
recommendation.body: Land or repair the narrow omitted-skill lookup path in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/42637, then evaluate priority and smart loading separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has recent skills prompt history and is already connected to the current omitted-key repair path in the issue discussion.
